title: Where Is the Coldest Place in the Universe?
description:
Where is the coldest natural place in the universe? The Boomerang Nebula.

Located 5,000 light years away, it has a temperature of just one Kelvin, which is minus 272 degrees Celsius. Rapidly expanding gas cooling creates this deep cosmic refrigerator.
